title: Identification of rice leaf diseases and deficiency disorders using a novel DeepBatch technique.
summary: The DeepBatch model identifies rice-leaf diseases and nutrient-deficiency disorders from plant images. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
ai_technology: The source evaluates image classification across rice disease/deficiency categories with held-out accuracy and baseline comparisons.
